capabilities: Sync the vault directly to an S3-compatible bucket over the S3 API
Encrypt file contents, paths, and folder structure client-side (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2) before upload
Preserve both versions of a file when two devices conflict, saving one as a conflicted copy
Trigger syncs on file changes, on a foreground timer, and on app open/resume
Export and import a recovery key for regaining access after a lost passphrase
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README recommends enabling bucket-level object versioning as a safety net, since the plugin has no in-app version history browser yet, and warns there is no server-side passphrase recovery — losing the passphrase and recovery key means losing the data.
intentEvidence: It exists as a personal alternative to Obsidian Sync's $4–8/mo subscription and to self-hosted CouchDB-based sync tools
motivation: The author wanted sync without Obsidian Sync's ongoing subscription cost and without the burden of running a CouchDB server, using object storage the user already controls.
problem: Obsidian Sync costs money indefinitely, and self-hosted CouchDB-based sync tools are free but require running and maintaining a server.

a bucket you own (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, or anything S3-compatible)

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault sync plugin that syncs directly to your own S3-compatible bucket (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2) with no server or subscription.
